Besides Lo ADU, the traditional rules include molad zaken, a molad at or after noon; GaTaRaD, Tuesday at or after 9 hours 204 parts in a common year; and BeTuTaKPaT, Monday at or after 15 hours 589 parts in a year following a leap year.
